fine_topics.name: Military Preparedness, Armed Forces & Veterans
fine_topics.definition: Organizing and equipping the militia, army, and navy, fortifications and armament, readiness in peacetime, and the care and honoring of veterans and service members.

fine_topics.name: Early Naval Wars: Barbary & the War of 1812
fine_topics.definition: Naval operations against the Barbary powers and the conduct of the War of 1812 with Britain, including maritime independence and honorable peace.

fine_topics.name: Mexican War
fine_topics.definition: The military conflict with Mexico, its justification through claims and annexation, and the conduct and settlement of the war.

fine_topics.name: World War I Mobilization & War Aims
fine_topics.definition: America's entry into the European war, the draft and supply machinery, and the assertion of unselfish national ideals and purposes.

fine_topics.name: World War II Military Operations
fine_topics.definition: Reports on the progress of the Second World War, battles in the Pacific and Europe, casualties, and the strategy of defeating Germany and Japan.

fine_topics.name: Vietnam War
fine_topics.definition: Justification of U.S. involvement in South Vietnam, war conduct and troop levels, prisoners, and the search for a negotiated peace.

fine_topics.name: Iraq, Gulf Wars, the War on Terror & Interventions
fine_topics.definition: Confronting Iraqi aggression and terrorism, combating al Qaeda and weapons of mass destruction, and armed interventions and peacekeeping in trouble spots.
